en.headline: Lee says five-year plan has 105 indicators drawn from mainland practice
en.dek: The chief executive told RTHK the targets were adapted to Hong Kong conditions and would be delivered through annual Policy Address goals, in a roughly three-to-one ratio.
body: Chief Executive John Lee said the targets in Hong Kong’s first five-year plan were drawn up with reference to how the mainland compiles its five-year plans, while taking account of local conditions so that measures keep a Hong Kong character and are suitable to implement here.

On RTHK’s Saturday Accountability programme, Lee said the number of main indicators was comparable to those in the national 15th Five-Year Plan and in plans issued by mainland local governments. Including boxed items, the document set out 105 indicators, all of which the government had to deliver.

He said delivery would run through each year’s Policy Address. This year’s address, he noted, set 284 indicators. Conceptually, he put the ratio of annual policy targets to five-year-plan indicators at about three to one.
Lee added that this was Hong Kong’s first five-year plan and that experience would have to be built up over time.

zh.headline: 李家超：五年規劃105項指標參考內地經驗
zh.dek: 特首在《星期六問責》表示，指標按香港實況制定，並透過每年施政報告落實，比例約為三比一。
body: 行政長官李家超表示，特區政府第一個五年規劃訂立的各項指標，參考了內地編製五年規劃的經驗，並綜合考慮香港實況，確保政策措施具香港特色，以及適合在本港推行。
他出席港台節目《星期六問責》時說，規劃提出的主要指標數目，與國家「十五五」規劃或其他內地政府相若；連同專欄在內，整份規劃共訂出105個指標，政府全部都要落實。
李家超解釋，落實方式是透過每年的施政報告。他指出，今年施政報告訂立了284個指標；以概念計算，年度施政指標與五年規劃指標約為三比一。
他強調，香港是第一次推行五年規劃，相關經驗需要逐步累積。
